title: Conditional RBAC as an Enterprise Add-on: pricing options and contract clause draft
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Define a negotiable, contract-ready clause and a simple pricing model for offering fine-grained RBAC and SSO/SAML features as enterprise add-ons. This ticket captures product decisions, trade-offs, a first draft contract language, experiment plan for pricing, and the implementation handoff. Background: Sales and Solutions Engineering report repeated RFIs asking for (1) guaranteed role-based access controls mapped to IdP attributes, (2) configurable audit log retention, and (3) SCIM/metadata onboarding for SAML. We need a packaging that balances commercial capture (upsell) and operational complexity for eng/support.
acceptance_criteria: Draft contract clause for SSO/SAML + RBAC add-on that legal preliminarily approves
Pricing model with 2 experiment arms (tiered per-seat delta and fixed add-on) and revenue/ARR impact estimates
Implementation backlog created in ENG with estimates for the MVP (attribute mapping, role admin UI, SCIM provisioning, audit log export)
Customer pilot list (3 customers) agreed with Sales and Solutions Engineering
Template negotiation redlines and playbook notes for AE use
notes: Current ask pattern: customers want explicit contractual commitments to role separation, admin audit trails, and IdP-based role assertions.
Engineering concern: supporting arbitrarily complex attribute-logic in the product increases support surface — propose a 'managed rules' approach for pilot customers.
Legal guidance requested on SLA language linking role-mapping failures to support response and credits — not to availability SLOs.
We should keep the self-serve sign-up experience unchanged; enterprise add-on is only surfaced in console and in contract negotiations for paid accounts.
links: https://linear.redwood.com/PM-45261 (related PM ticket: enterprise access packaging)
decisions: Offer RBAC as a purchasable add-on with two SKU experiments: (A) per-seat role tier delta and (B) fixed annual add-on with up to N role mappings included.
SAML support will include SP-initiated for self-serve and IdP-initiated + metadata upload for enterprise add-on customers.
SCIM provisioning will be included in the enterprise add-on MVP for pilot customers; general availability depends on pilot results and engineering capacity.
Audit log retention extension (90 days) to be packaged as part of the enterprise add-on rather than a separate charge initially.
Implement 'managed rules' as an interim for complex attribute transforms to reduce engineering productization risk during pilot.
risks: Product complexity: offering arbitrary attribute transforms could require a mini rule-engine and create long-term maintenance burden.
Sales friction: if pricing delta is too high, AEs may push customers to custom contracts or delay procurement.
Legal/regulatory: holding RBAC guarantees in contract could create exposure if role-mapping changes cause data access issues — need explicit limitation of liability language.
SRE impact: audit retention increases storage and ingestion costs; we need a cost pass-through or quota to avoid margin erosion.
experiment_plan: Arm A: per-seat RBAC delta — +$2-4 / seat / month, measured across 6 pilots. Track conversion and churn.
Arm B: fixed annual enterprise add-on — $18k/year for accounts under 5k MAU, measured in negotiation win-rate.
Metric targets: >15% attach rate in closed-won deals for pilot accounts, <2% increased support load during pilot, positive NPV at 18 months.
Pilot length: 90 days per customer with checkpoints at 30/60/90 days.
